nphi.title: Lancang-Mekong Subregional Joint Laboratory Network for Tropical Disease Control
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Partner institutions in the Lancang-Mekong subregion
nphi.summary: Network launched in 2025 at the RNAS+ annual meeting, with an MoU signed by NIPD to link tropical-disease laboratories of the five Mekong countries on shared objectives, target diseases and a work plan.

nphi.title: China CDC – Myanmar National CDC memorandum of cooperation
nphi.with: Myanmar National Centre for Disease Control and Medical Training Centre (Myanmar National CDC)
nphi.summary: In June 2024 China CDC signed a memorandum of cooperation with Myanmar's newly built National CDC. It covers infectious and chronic disease control, laboratory capacity, health promotion and health emergency response.

nphi.title: KDCA support to ASEAN infectious disease early warning and risk assessment
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Funds and supports the operation of an ASEAN regional system for infectious disease early warning and risk assessment.

nphi.title: CDC Southeast Asia Regional Office
nphi.with: Host ministries of health; ASEAN
nphi.summary: CDC's SEA regional office in Hanoi (2021) coordinates seven bilateral country offices and ASEAN partnerships on AMR, One Health, border health, lab systems, emergency management and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: ACPHEED – regional ASEAN centre for public health emergencies (Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam)
nphi.actor: ASEAN Centre for Public Health Emergencies and Emerging Diseases (ACPHEED), secretariat hosted by Thailand
nphi.with: ASEAN Member States' health ministries; Japan-ASEAN Integration Fund (JAIF); Australian Government
nphi.summary: Regional ASEAN centre announced in November 2020 and set up across three host countries, with the secretariat office in Thailand and further hubs in Indonesia and Viet Nam; Japan committed US$50 million and Australia AU$21 million to…

nphi.title: ASEAN Emergency Operations Centre Network for public health emergencies
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health Malaysia (lead, ASEAN EOC Network)
nphi.with: Public health emergency operations centres of ASEAN Member States
nphi.summary: Network of national public health EOCs set up by ASEAN Member States around 2017 to coordinate emergency preparedness and response, later led by Malaysia; it held regional meetings and tabletop exercises during COVID-19.

nphi.title: IANPHI Asia Regional Network
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Mongolia (vice chair); IEDCR Bangladesh; School of Public Health and Community Medicine Nepal; National Institute of Public Health Japan; National Centre for Disease Control India; National Health Laboratory Myanmar
nphi.summary: Regional network of Asian NPHIs launched in 2016 with China CDC as chair and eight founding members, modelled on the IANPHI Africa network to foster cooperation among Asian institutes; it now counts 28 NPHIs.

nphi.title: CDC Burma (Myanmar) country office
nphi.with: National AIDS Program; National Health Laboratory; Myanmar FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's Burma office (2015) supports HIV/TB via PEPFAR with the National AIDS Program and National Health Laboratory, and runs the FETP as its flagship global health security programme.

nphi.title: China–Myanmar workshop on malaria elimination and infectious disease control
nphi.with: Myanmar Ministry of Health; National Center for Diseases Control and Medical Training Center; National Malaria Control Program
nphi.summary: Annual bilateral workshop held since 2014, alternating between China and Myanmar, on malaria elimination in the border area and wider infectious disease control. The 8th edition was in Nay Pyi Taw in 2024.

nphi.title: Mitigation of Biological Threats (MBT) in the ASEAN Region Program
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat; ASEAN EOC Network; ASEAN BioDiaspora Virtual Center; ACPHEED; PHAC (participant)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded ASEAN programme, running since 2014, that strengthens regional biosafety, biosecurity, surveillance and preparedness. It helped set up the ASEAN EOC Network and the BioDiaspora Virtual Center. Phase 3 (2024–2027) was…

nphi.title: ASEAN+3 Field Epidemiology Training Network (ASEAN+3 FETN)
nphi.actor: Ministry of Public Health, Thailand (Department of Disease Control)
nphi.with: FETP programmes of ASEAN Member States and China, Japan, Korea; ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Regional network linking field epidemiology training programmes across ASEAN and China, Japan and Korea, set up in Bangkok in 2011 with Thailand's Ministry of Public Health endorsed as focal point.

nphi.title: SEAOHUN – Southeast Asia One Health University Network
nphi.actor: Southeast Asia One Health University Network (SEAOHUN), Chiang Mai University
nphi.with: 67 universities in national One Health university networks; USAID; KOICA; US Department of State
nphi.summary: Regional university network founded in 2011, with its secretariat at Chiang Mai University, that builds the One Health workforce through curricula, exchanges, fellowships and joint projects in Southeast Asia.

nphi.title: Mekong Basin Disease Surveillance (MBDS) network
nphi.with: Ministries of health / disease control departments of the six Mekong Basin countries; MBDS Foundation
nphi.summary: Regional network founded in 2001 under a health-ministerial MoU linking six Mekong countries for cross-border surveillance, outbreak investigation and response, information sharing and capacity building; secretariat c/o Thailand's DDC.

nphi.title: IMR as SEAMEO TROPMED Regional Centre for Microbiology, Parasitology and Entomology
nphi.with: SEAMEO TROPMED Network
nphi.summary: IMR has hosted the SEAMEO TROPMED regional centre for microbiology, parasitology and entomology since 1967, running regional diploma courses for Southeast Asian health professionals; it is also a WHO collaborating centre for vector…

nphi.title: China Public Health Team deployment to Myanmar after the 2025 earthquake
nphi.with: Myanmar health authorities (unnamed); Yunnan CDC
nphi.summary: China CDC experts and Yunnan CDC formed a public health team that carried out risk assessment, water testing, vector surveillance, disinfection and vaccination guidance, and trained local staff after the 7.9-magnitude earthquake.

nphi.title: China CDC technical support for Myanmar CDC development
nphi.with: Myanmar National Center for Disease Control (Myanmar CDC); Myanmar Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: During a 2023 visit by Myanmar's deputy health minister, China CDC offered to share experience and give technical support for building and running Myanmar's national CDC. Both sides proposed cooperation on malaria, HIV, TB and dengue,…

nphi.title: ICMR-NIV mpox diagnostic training for South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.with: Health and laboratory staff of nine South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: During the 2022 mpox outbreak, ICMR-NIV Pune trained health workers from nine Asian countries in mpox testing, case definitions, sample collection and lab equipment. It also offered testing kits, reagents and probes on request.

nphi.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
nphi.with: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
nphi.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).

nphi.title: ICMR – Myanmar Department of Medical Research MoU
nphi.with: Department of Medical Research (DMR), Ministry of Health and Sports Myanmar
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and Myanmar's Department of Medical Research on joint medical research.

nphi.title: SATREPS: antimicrobial resistance surveillance in Myanmar
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory (NHL)
nphi.summary: Juntendo University SATREPS project with Myanmar's National Health Laboratory to establish AMR surveillance.

nphi.title: Myanmar National Health Laboratory Project
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory (NHL) Myanmar; Ministry of Health and Sports; Fondation Mérieux; AFD; European Union
nphi.summary: AFD- and EU-funded project to build a BSL3 reference laboratory and upgrade Myanmar's National Health Laboratory in Yangon and Mandalay, with Institut Pasteur leading staff training.

nphi.title: ASEAN-Australia Health Security Fellowships (Master of Applied Epidemiology)
nphi.with: ASEAN ministries of health; DFAT
nphi.summary: Fellowship programme agreed after the 2018 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, in which ASEAN health officials complete ANU's applied epidemiology degree while working in their home institutions and Australian fellows do field placements in…

nphi.title: NCGM–Myanmar Ministry of Health MoU
nphi.with: Health Bureau, Ministry of Health and Sports, Myanmar
nphi.summary: An MoU signed in April 2014 for joint research, mainly through JICA projects.

nphi.title: Workshop for field epidemiology officials from Asian countries (CFETP, MOFCOM-funded)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; Ministry of Commerce (aid training)
nphi.summary: CFETP hosted a three-week aid-funded workshop in Beijing for 20 field epidemiology officials from seven Asian countries. It was the second such workshop for Asian countries, and a 2015 round followed.

nphi.title: China–Myanmar cross-border malaria control under the Global Fund (rounds 6 and 10)
nphi.with: Myanmar Ministry of Health and Sports; Health Poverty Action; Myanmar special region health authorities
nphi.summary: The Yunnan Institute of Parasitic Diseases and Health Poverty Action ran Global Fund malaria projects in Chinese border counties and Myanmar special regions. The work followed a 2005 China–Myanmar health ministry agreement on cross-border…

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: WHO SEARO
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: Thailand NIH regional laboratory collaboration
nphi.summary: In an IANPHI-funded project, Thailand's NIH worked with labs in Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Bhutan on techniques, biosafety and external quality assurance. In 2012 it coordinated with Cambodia and Vietnam on hand, foot and mouth disease…

nphi.title: Niigata University – Myanmar National Health Laboratory respiratory infection research (J-GRID+)
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory, Myanmar
nphi.summary: Roughly decade-long collaboration on surveillance and molecular epidemiology of respiratory infections in Myanmar.

nphi.title: JICA Adviser for Infectious Disease Control and Laboratory Services (Myanmar NHL)
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory (NHL), Ministry of Health and Sports
nphi.summary: JICA technical cooperation placing an adviser on infectious disease control and laboratory services with Myanmar's National Health Laboratory, covering HIV, TB, AMR and laboratory inspection; it also supplied COVID-19 primers and reagents…

indicators.label: E. coli bloodstream infections resistant to 3rd-generation cephalosporins
